description: §38.10.3 (S462) — an `onclient:*` handler declared as a plain `function` whose body calls `broadcast()` is placed on the server by §12.2 Trigger 7, and fires E-CHANNEL-006. Before S462 route inference exempted the handler from Trigger 7: it compiled at exit 0 into the client bundle calling a `broadcast()` the client does not define.
rationale: §38.10.3 (ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 "a"): a function designated as the handler for an `onclient:*` attribute SHALL NOT be placed on the server by §12.2; §12.2 Trigger 7 places a channel-body function that calls `broadcast()`.
